items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution due to improper neutralization of special elements in a template engine, actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVSS 9.1), security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Improper Access Control / Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: An improper access control vulnerability allowing an attacker to bypass security features and access unauthorized functionality, shipped with the August 2026 patch set.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.
